MINIMUM_TOTAL_IF_MESOI_10PP_AND_DELTA_MC.NOTE: MESOI 10pp at DEFF 3 ⇒ T≥107 (≥72 at DEFF 2); δ_mc 0.15 ⇒ ≥63 MINORITY_CORRECT items within it; per-class descriptive only

BATTERY_COMPOSITION.PILOT_CALIBRATION: E1 pilot (disjoint item set) sets difficulty labels so that mean Stage-1 single-node accuracy per class lies in 0.35–0.85 (avoid floor/ceiling); pilot items are never reused in E2
BATTERY_COMPOSITION.BASIS: G06 §6 precision plan (assumptions, not empirical effect sizes): (i) factorial interactions: 5 pp MESOI, n=3 nodes, R=3 runs, 16 cells, DEFF 2, Bonferroni α=0.05/8, power 0.80 ⇒ T ≥ 285 total; (ii) central-test minority-correct retention non-inferiority margin 0.10 in stratum S* (p_decisive_correct 0.7, DEFF 1.5) ⇒ ≥141 MINORITY_CORRECT tasks; (iii) error-correlation non-inferiority margin 0.10 ⇒ T ≥ 154 (φ0=0.2, DEFF 2). Composition 6×43 + 142 = 400 satisfies all three. Margin 0.05 on error correlation would need T≈469–629 at R=3 (or R=5 with T≈281–378).
BATTERY_COMPOSITION.PER_CLASS_INFERENCE: Descriptive only (43 items per class is under-powered for class-level interactions)
